ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

counter.label: Limited to 20 characters
counter.note: Automatically shown when maxlength is set on the native input, or when a Validators.maxLength error is active on the control.

form-field.description: Visual, semantic, and accessible shell for form controls with label, hint, error, prefix, suffix, and state visualisation.

error.custom: This field has a custom error.
error.email: Please enter a valid email address.
error.projected: Projected: please enter a valid email.

examples.note: Label provided via input attribute. The wrapper owns the outer height through the 3x3 size x density matrix.

hint.password: Use at least 8 characters with a number and a symbol.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the form field with an input directive.

loading.label: Postal code
loading.note: Renders a spinner in the suffix slot while async work runs. Loading suppresses any other suffix content and sets aria-busy on the field.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: The control wrapper supports none, sm (default), md, lg, and xl radius values. Global scale: md maps to 4px, lg to 8px, and xl renders as a pill.

size-density.note: Size (sm, md, lg) combined with density selects one of the 9 control-height tokens, so the outer height always matches the matrix.

form-field.title: Form Field

validation.note: Required field with Reactive Forms. Error appears after interaction and blur, but not while focused. Manual invalid overrides automatic detection.
